title: Cellular gateway firmware versions MG 4.1 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new beta cellularGateway firmware is now available on Wed, 30 Apr 2025

Important notices: Applying this firmware will upgrade the firmware of the Modems on MG51 and MG52. This upgrade begins automatically after the MG has finished upgrading to MG 4.1. This upgrade will require 250 MB of data and up to 20 minutes (depending on bandwidth) to complete if uninterrupted. Please contact Meraki Support if you have any additional questions or require assistance.
New feature highlights: Cellular modem firmware version is now visible in Dashboard
Added new SIM Operator IDs for Telus and T-Mobile
New APN added for Telus support
Bug fixes: MG-4766: {MG21} Fixed an issue that prevented connectivity to dashboard after rebooting on MG 3.212+
MG-4464: {MG51} Fixed an issue that caused modem resets due to Driver errors
MG-1246: {MG21} Fixed an issue where API Calls to endpoints would return "Not running configured version"

html:
Cellular gateway firmware versions MG 4.1 changelog

Important notices

  • Applying this firmware will upgrade the firmware of the Modems on MG51 and MG52. This upgrade begins automatically after the MG has finished upgrading to MG 4.1. This upgrade will require 250 MB of data and up to 20 minutes (depending on bandwidth) to complete if uninterrupted. Please contact Meraki Support if you have any additional questions or require assistance.

New feature highlights

  • Cellular modem firmware version is now visible in Dashboard
  • Added new SIM Operator IDs for Telus and T-Mobile
  • Additional Verizon 5G APNs added
  • New APN added for Telus support

Bug fixes

  • MG-4766: {MG21} Fixed an issue that prevented connectivity to dashboard after rebooting on MG 3.212+
  • MG-4464: {MG51} Fixed an issue that caused modem resets due to Driver errors
  • MG-1246: {MG21} Fixed an issue where API Calls to endpoints would return "Not running configured version"
